properties.displayName: [Custom] Kubernetes cluster containers should have CPU and memory limits within bounds
properties.description: Custom OPA/Rego-backed Azure Policy definition. Wraps the open-source Gatekeeper library's K8sContainerLimits constraint template (https://github.com/open-policy-agent/gatekeeper-library/tree/master/library/general/containerlimits) to require containers set CPU/memory limits and cap them at the given maximums.

metadata.description: 'audit' allows a non-compliant resource to be created but flags it as non-compliant. 'deny' blocks the non-compliant resource from being created. 'disabled' turns off the policy.
The maximum allowed CPU limit on a container, exclusive. Set to '-1' to disable the CPU check.
The maximum allowed memory limit on a container, exclusive. Set to '-1' to disable the memory check.
Container images (exact match, or prefix match ending in '*') excluded from enforcement.
List of Kubernetes namespaces to include in policy evaluation. An empty list means all namespaces not explicitly excluded.
List of Kubernetes namespaces to exclude from policy evaluation.
